turns.question: Which 8-K filings from February and March 2026 report entering into or terminating a material definitive agreement under Item 1.01 or 1.02? Summarize three of the agreements, and cite the filings.

report.markdown:
Based on the SEC filings search, I found multiple 8-K filings from February and March 2026 reporting Item 1.01 (Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement) or Item 1.02 (Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement). Here are three notable examples:

### Filings Reporting Item 1.01 or 1.02 (February–March 2026)

| Company | Ticker | Filing Date | Event Date | Item | Agreement Type |
|---------|--------|-------------|------------|------|----------------|
| Salesforce, Inc. | CRM | 2026-03-12 | 2026-03-11 | 1.01 | Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR) Agreements |
| Netflix, Inc. | NFLX | 2026-02-27 | 2026-02-27 | 1.02 | Termination of Merger Agreement with Warner Bros. Discovery |
| Oracle Corporation | ORCL | 2026-02-04 | 2026-02-02 | 1.01 | Equity Distribution Agreement (ATM Offering) |
| Amgen Inc. | AMGN | 2026-02-19 | 2026-02-17 | 1.01 | Senior Notes Offering ($1B + $1.75B) |
| Amazon.com, Inc. | AMZN | 2026-02-27 | 2026-02-27 | 1.01 | Material Definitive Agreement (details in filing) |
| NIKE, Inc. | NKE | 2026-03-09 | 2026-03-06 | 1.01 | 364-Day Credit Facility ($1B) |
| Applied Digital Corp. | APLD | 2026-03-04 | 2026-02-26 | 1.01 | Guarantee to Babcock & Wilcox |
| Applied Digital Corp. | APLD | 2026-02-17 | 2026-02-15 | 1.01 | Contribution and Exchange Agreement |

---

### Summaries of Three Agreements

#### 1. **Salesforce (CRM) — $25 Billion Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreements**
**Filing:** 8-K filed 2026-03-12 (accession 0001193125-26-104282), Item 1.01
**Date of Agreement:** March 11, 2026
Salesforce entered into accelerated share repurchase agreements (ASR Agreements) with Banco Santander, Bank of America, Citibank, JPMorgan Chase, and Morgan Stanley to repurchase an aggregate **$25 billion** of its common stock. The board had authorized a total of $50 billion for repurchases in February 2026. Salesforce will pay $25 billion on March 16, 2026 and receive initial deliveries of ~80% of shares based on the March 11 closing price; final settlement is scheduled for Q4 2026 [1].

#### 2. **Netflix (NFLX) — Termination of Merger Agreement with Warner Bros. Discovery**
**Filing:** 8-K filed 2026-02-27 (accession 0001193125-26-082247), Item 1.02
**Date of Termination:** February 27, 2026
Netflix reported the **termination** of the Amended and Restated Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") originally entered on January 19, 2026 among Netflix, Nightingale Sub, Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), and New Topco 25. On February 26, WBD notified Netflix that a revised proposal from Paramount Skydance constituted a "Company Superior Proposal." Netflix waived its right to negotiate, and on February 27, WBD terminated the Merger Agreement to enter into a merger with Paramount Skydance. Paramount Skydance paid WBD's $2.8 billion termination fee to Netflix [2].

#### 3. **Oracle (ORCL) — $20 Billion Equity Distribution Agreement (ATM Offering)**
**Filing:** 8-K filed 2026-02-04 (accession 0001193125-26-037840), Item 1.01
**Date of Agreement:** February 2, 2026
Oracle entered into an **Equity Distribution Agreement** with BofA Securities, Citigroup Global Markets, Deutsche Bank Securities, Goldman Sachs, and J.P. Morgan Securities as sales agents to sell up to **$20 billion** of its common stock through an "at-the-market" (ATM) offering program. Additional agents (HSBC, BNP Paribas, PNC, SMBC Nikko, Santander, TD Securities, BNY Mellon, Credit Agricole, ING, Wells Fargo) joined via joinder agreements on February 3, 2026. Sales agents will use reasonable efforts to sell shares based on Oracle's instructions [3].

---

### Limitations
- The search returned 32 candidate filings in the SEC Filings source for the period; the table above lists those most clearly identified in the top results. Additional filings with Item 1.01/1.02 may exist in the full set.
- Filings are not joined to price data; this summary reflects only the disclosure text in the 8-K passages retrieved.

hits.snippet: a Delaware corporation (“Netflix”), Nightingale Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of Netflix (“Merger Sub”), Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“WBD”), and New Topco 25, Inc., a newly formed Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of WBD (“Newco”), entered into an Amended and Restated Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”), pursuant to which, upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Merger Agreement, among other things, (i) a newly formed Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of Newco would merge with and into WBD (the “Holdco Merger”) in accordance with Section 251(g) of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware, with WBD surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Newco and with the stockholders of WBD immediately prior to the effective time of the Holdco Merger becoming the stockholders of Newco at and immediately following the effective time of the Holdco Merger, and (ii) following an internal reorganization and the separation and distribution of WBD’s Global Linear Networks business and certain other assets, as a result of which Newco would hold the Streaming & Studios businesses of WBD (the “Retained Business”), Merger Sub would merge with and into Newco, with Newco surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Netflix.
